in_marathi.name: Kalishankar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Time and Death
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kalishankar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kali - Goddess of Time and Destruction, Shankar - God of Destruction and Time. The name Kalishankar signifies the God who embodies both destruction and the passing of time.

in_bengali.long_meaning: Kalishankar একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Kali - Goddess of Time and Destruction, Shankar - God of Destruction and Time. The name Kalishankar signifies the God who embodies both destruction and the passing of time.
